design_scope: Fixed-shape 2D convolution: 8x8 input image, 3x3 kernel, 6x6 output feature map (36 pixels).
timing_disclaimer: 100 MHz (10 ns period) is an assumed nominal reference clock for cycle-to-time conversions, NOT a signed-off Static Timing Analysis (STA) timing closure. Synthesis gate counts represent generic standard CMOS logic cells (cmos2: NOT, AND, OR) via Yosys 0.70 + ABC.
area_disclaimer: Standard cell counts represent generic Boolean logic gates (cmos2 library: NOT, AND, OR) mapped via Yosys + ABC. These quantify relative logical gate complexity, NOT physical silicon layout area (um^2/mm^2), which requires technology PDK standard cell libraries and physical place-and-route (P&R).
routing_disclaimer: Wire counts and wire bits represent internal Yosys RTLIL logical netlist nets, NOT physical layout routing tracks or parasitic interconnect metrics.
relu_redundancy_note: For unsigned 8-bit inputs and weights ([0, 255]), all products and sums are strictly non-negative (>= 0). Thus, ReLU(X) = max(0, X) == X is mathematically redundant for this unsigned datapath and serves as an architectural placeholder for signed extensions.

timing_analysis.timing_closure_disclaimer: 100.0 MHz (10.0 ns period) is an assumed nominal reference clock for cycle-to-time conversion, NOT a signed-off physical Static Timing Analysis (STA) timing closure. Technology-independent logic depth quantifies gate levels and arithmetic carry chains, but true physical delay requires standard cell transistor models (Liberty .lib), PVT corner derating, clock tree synthesis, and post-routing RC extraction (SPEF).

serial_baseline.name: Architecture A (Serial Baseline)
serial_baseline.critical_path_description: Register output (kr_r/kc_r/acc_r) -> 2D address generation -> 8x8-bit unsigned multiplier (img_data * kernel_data) -> 24-bit sequential accumulator adder -> acc_r / out_data DFF input
serial_baseline.timing_criticality: Low - Single MAC unit with short combinational feedback path

parallel_9mac.name: Architecture B (Parallel 9-MAC)
parallel_9mac.critical_path_description: Register output (img_buf/kernel_buf) -> 9 parallel 8x8-bit unsigned multipliers -> 3-stage combinational adder tree (Stage 1: 16b+16b->17b; Stage 2: 17b+17b->18b; Stage 3: 18b+18b->19b, +18b->20b) -> ReLU zero extension -> out_data DFF input
parallel_9mac.longest_path_component: 3-stage combinational adder tree summation across 9 parallel products
parallel_9mac.timing_criticality: High - The non-pipelined 3-stage adder tree forms the primary frequency bottleneck. At 100 MHz reference clock, combinational propagation must complete within 10.0 ns. In physical deep-submicron implementation, pipelining the adder tree with 1-2 register stages would improve maximum attainable Fmax at the expense of 1-2 cycles initial latency.

serial_baseline.name: Architecture A (Serial Baseline)
serial_baseline.memory_implementation: Streaming on-the-fly address generation (Zero internal buffer storage registers).

parallel_9mac.name: Architecture B (Parallel 9-MAC + Combinational Tree)
parallel_9mac.memory_implementation: Multi-Port Register Array (584 DFFs: 512 img + 72 krn). Concurrent 9-pixel and 9-weight spatial reads per cycle preclude standard 1R/1W SRAM macro blocks.
parallel_9mac.adder_tree_type: Single-Cycle Combinational Adder Tree (Non-pipelined, 3 stages logic)
parallel_9mac.critical_path_stages: 1 Multiplier + 3-Stage Combinational Adder Tree (~68 gate levels)
